corpus.source: bundled prompt fields and schedule status/scene/action from repository data JSON

fixture.prompt_distribution: seeded repository-asset-derived synthetic prompts; 35% append a second corpus phrase; original_prompt/request_prompt are both indexed and prompt is duplicated every seventh record; controlled 10% prefix and 10% post-prefix marker probes

methodology.connection_lifetime: each operation commits/rolls back and closes; no anchor connection
methodology.cache_evict: checkpoint and close, then POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED best-effort hint; does not prove cold storage
methodology.statistics: nearest-rank p95 is the maximum with fewer than 20 samples; synthetic device-local evidence only
methodology.concurrency: shared instance RLock serializes query/write calls; write_progress_observed means writes completed in the query window, not simultaneous SQL execution; independent instances model additional WAL contention
